title: <name> and the Great Toy Train Rescue

pages.text: One bright morning, <name> was playing with his shiny red toy train when—uh-oh!—it rolled right off the track and onto the tallest shelf in his room.
'Oh no! My train!' <name> gasped, looking up. It was way too high! But he wasn’t giving up. 'Rescue mission time!' he said bravely.

He stacked soft pillows into a big mountain. 'Climb carefully,' meowed his curious cat, Milo, watching from below. <name> started his climb — step, step, wobble! The pillows slid, and a ball rolled past like a sneaky boulder. 'Whoa!' he giggled, dodging it just in time.

'Don’t worry, Milo, I’ve got this!' <name> said, reaching for the shelf. But it was still a little far. Milo gave a playful 'meow!' and nudged a blanket closer with his paw. <name> used it to climb a little higher — and grabbed the train!
'Mission complete!' he cheered, holding it high. Milo meowed proudly, and <name> drove the train around the room again — chugga-chugga choo-choo!
Everyone clapped as the brave rescuer smiled wide. The toy train was safe, and <name> was the hero of the day!
